name: Produkte PDF
description: Feeds the product page's 'Download' tab, grouped into three sections: 2D, 3D and Digital Catalog. IMPORTANT: Frappe fieldnames can't start with a digit, so the columns are named attach_2d/attach_3d here, but api.py must re-key them to the literal JSON keys "2d"/"3d" the frontend already expects (see README API contract). katalog needs no remap since it's already a valid identifier.
